title: Elite Tier Reduction on Summit Reinstatement Fees
content:
Elite members of the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program pay less to reinstate expired miles. The reduction follows the tier the member holds and whether that tier's validity runs through the day of the reinstatement, as the membership record's tier and valid-through date show them.

1. Summit Gold, Summit Platinum, Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman, still valid on the day of the reinstatement: 100 USD taken off.
2. Summit Silver, still valid on the day of the reinstatement: 50 USD taken off.
3. Otherwise, as for Summit Member: nothing taken off.

A tier is still valid on the day of the reinstatement when its valid-through date is that day or a later day.

The reduction is taken off the fee to pay and never takes it below zero.

**Hypothetical cases**

| Tier on record | Valid through | Day of reinstatement | Taken off (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Platinum | 31 January 2027 | 12 June 2026 | 100 |
| Summit Silver | 12 June 2026 | 12 June 2026 | 50 |
| Summit Member | | 12 June 2026 | None |
